description: HTML source code for a web-based database viewer dashboard, including embedded CSS for styling and JavaScript for dynamic data fetching, interaction, and rendering of database, table, and data views.
published: HTML elements with IDs: dbList, contentHeader, contentBody

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads database list upon refresh button click.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in the main panel.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays an HTML table with data, handling wide content and correlations.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates the HTML for a cell, including clickable content for long text or objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full visibility.
